title: Extractable SLEEP and teachability bootstrap v7
summary: Preserve exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP. A one-time target-blind T-versus-D birth bootstrap may prepare the child to use later parenting; repetition stays in waking THINK. Personal SLEEP resolves only mechanically established child-authored grounded propositions, constructs a fresh-from-birth candidate under finite cumulative coverage and dose, closes it before staging, and promotes it only by one atomic full-head compare-and-swap.
system_thesis: THINK is the continuing waking thought-action-public-outcome stream. DREAM only manages disposable waking context. SLEEP re-expresses and writes grounded propositions the child already authored into its personal LoRA. Parenting and repetition can affect SLEEP only by changing what the child itself later thinks, does, and grounds in the world.

nodes.before: Evidence, lessons, augmented views, and optimizer exposure can be conflated.
nodes.after: Immutable public action-outcome evidence IDs, supported lesson IDs, rendered view IDs, supervised-token exposures, and optimizer updates are separate counted objects.
nodes.rationale: Experience count, augmentation, and SGD dose answer different causal questions.

nodes.before: V6 did not give the resolver its complete frozen decision contract.
nodes.after: SLEEP selects, orders, deduplicates, contrasts, replays, paraphrases, and renders only clauses mechanically admitted under the exact support and coverage-dose contracts; it never invents missing child semantics.
nodes.rationale: Compilation enriches the child's experience without becoming a thinker.

nodes.before: V6 combined candidate construction with preclosure snapshot binding.
nodes.after: E4_CANDIDATE_CONSTRUCTOR receives only immutable birth, a fresh zero-effective-delta initializer, the full cumulative eligible child corpus, frozen writer/support/coverage-dose contracts, and the bound seed; it seals candidate bytes and construction trace without active-head, CAS, verdict, evaluation, parent, repetition, DREAM, science, audit, authority, or release access.
nodes.rationale: Candidate construction is a pure reproducible function of birth plus admitted life.

nodes.before: Bootstrap persistence and personal LoRA ancestry are ambiguous.
nodes.after: Teachability T and direct-solution D adapters are produced once from the same frozen M0 and exact paired corpus, merged under a prospectively frozen materialization contract, rounded and serialized once, and sealed as distinct immutable births. M0 is retained only as a separate competence-and-damage diagnostic.
nodes.rationale: The birth intervention persists while remaining separate from personal experiential memory.

nodes.before: A semantically undefined neutral bootstrap could be easier, harmful, or secretly teach the treatment computation.
nodes.after: Every T/D pair shares one state, canonical rational action, public outcome, admission decision, action position, supervised-token opportunity, and optimizer opportunity. T demonstrates exactly one declared general feedback-to-action computation before that action; D receives the same action directly. Neither arm contains downstream-derived or policy-isomorphic final-task information.
nodes.rationale: This distinguishes learning-readiness from preloaded task skill without pretending the control is semantically neutral.

nodes.before: A sequential before/after assay mixes advice with practice and outcome feedback.
nodes.after: Disposable same-state clones receive correct, none, irrelevant, or wrong byte-fixed advice with no SLEEP or lineage write.
nodes.rationale: This isolates immediate selective advice use at birth.

nodes.before: Adaptive parent behavior and SLEEP obscure whether the child learns faster from the same teaching.
nodes.after: The fixed controller receives only immutable outbound lesson bytes keyed by ages 1, 9, 17, and 25, a monotone external schedule cursor, and write-only parent-audit append. It cannot read child behavior, outcomes, adaptive state, its audit history, SLEEP, candidates, exams, or scores. Opposite mock histories receive identical bytes at the same ages.
nodes.rationale: Fixed repetition must be exogenous; adaptive parenting is a separately labeled package.

nodes.before: Child receptivity and the ecological parent-child system can be conflated.
nodes.after: A separately labeled adaptive parent-plus-child-plus-SLEEP 2x2 records all parent information and effort and uses disposable clean-context exams.
nodes.rationale: The practical developmental package is valuable but is not parenting-alone or a weight-only mediator.

nodes.before: Directory scans can admit rejected corpora, briefs, adapters, or incomplete transactions.
nodes.after: No semantic stage receives a composite lineage head. Immutable birth, active weights, eligible life evidence, staged candidate closure, non-dereferenceable candidate root, equality-only committed CAS token, parent audit, and repetition state are separate. Every capability names one operation and one lifecycle epoch; undeclared operations and cross-capability dereference are forbidden.
nodes.rationale: A composite head can bypass the parent/repetition firewall and candidate isolation even when prose calls it opaque.

nodes.before: Mixed repetition state could enter semantic SLEEP.
nodes.after: Reminder schedule/count/order and adaptive acquisition/relapse state are parent/auditor control-plane data only. Child-authored grounded enactments enter SLEEP solely through ordinary life evidence.
nodes.rationale: Repetition guides parenting without becoming an indirect teacher-to-gradient channel.

nodes.before: Context state could become an undeclared memory authority.
nodes.after: DREAM emits a disposable waking cache bound separately to the exact active-weight, committed-child-trace, public-observation, current-live-parent-message, and prior-cache roots it was allowed to read. It is rebuilt when any named source changes and forbidden to personal SLEEP as evidence or conditioning.
nodes.rationale: DREAM manages waking consciousness without a composite lineage capability or persistent evidence authority.

nodes.before: Candidate gates and scientific evaluation shared one score type.
nodes.after: A private staged evaluator reads the candidate, previous child, and frozen preservation panel; it emits only preservation evidence and a staged promotion verdict.
nodes.rationale: Safety evidence may decide a write without contaminating scientific evaluation or later learning.

nodes.before: V6 used equality followed by a separate generic weight write.
nodes.after: The lineage store exposes one PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC operation binding expected complete head, staged candidate, preservation verdict, replacement root, life/transaction namespace, nonce, and one-shot idempotency. Success changes the active root and emits its receipt in one linearizable transaction; failure changes nothing.
nodes.rationale: There is no check-then-write race.

nodes.before: Disposable exam products could be confused with promotion evidence.
nodes.after: Each disposable exam is split into a fresh model executor that sees public input plus active weights, a model-free truth scorer that sees the closed transcript plus hidden truth, and a reporter that sees only frozen score records. None feeds child, parent, DREAM, SLEEP, candidate, promotion, audit authority, or release.
nodes.rationale: No component may possess model execution, hidden answers, and prior scientific products together.

nodes.before: V6 did not bind the wrapper's concrete artifact class and underlying root through the transfer.
nodes.after: Release is a one-shot TRANSFER_OPAQUE over a sealed RELEASE_TARGET_ARTIFACT wrapper that equality-binds the complete nine-field tuple to its concrete payload class and root. It consumes a separate exact external authorization and producer-closed narrow attestations.
nodes.rationale: Every wrapper, class, root, destination, protocol, scope, nonce, expiry, or idempotency substitution fails closed.

nodes.before: V6 lacked the new resolver, stager, analysis, opportunity, and atomic-promotion capabilities.
nodes.after: The exact registry 9c44fe870c56f3009b08512d48175c50a1378beeeebc378a7cfff2e89548c94d defines 98 single-consumer capabilities, 53 artifact classes, 63 explicit bridges, PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC, exact producers/lifetimes/failures, and the complete release tuple. The full visibility matrix is generated from these bytes.
nodes.rationale: All repaired flows are enumerable; ambient and cross-epoch access remains impossible.

nodes.before: V6 left semantic support authority ambient.
nodes.after: A model-free resolver consumes the committed child trace, matching public observation, and exact FROZEN_SUPPORT_RESOLVER_CONTRACT. The contract fully defines authorship, commit identity, temporal order, same-life grounding, semantic dimensions, bidirectional meaning preservation, clause thresholds, disputes, missing evidence, and undecidable rejection. It cannot infer a missing conclusion.
nodes.rationale: Eligibility becomes constructible, content-addressed, and fail closed.

nodes.after: A stateless controller emits only the immutable lesson bytes named by the monotone external cursor, appends a write-only audit event, and advances the cursor once. It has no child-conditioned or self-history input.
nodes.rationale: The fixed arm estimates repeated teaching under a genuinely exogenous policy.

nodes.after: A fresh executor reads one public exam input and active weights, emits an immutable transcript, and is destroyed; it cannot read truth, scores, prior transcripts, reports, or lineage state.
nodes.rationale: The tested model must not be conditioned on answers or prior results.

nodes.after: A model-free scorer reads only a closed transcript and frozen hidden truth, emits a typed score, and cannot call a model, edit the transcript, or access continuing lineage.
nodes.rationale: Truth can grade without teaching or selecting the learner.

nodes.before: V6 reporter assignment and labels were not producer-closed.
nodes.after: The reporter reads frozen score records plus a separately delivered FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET binding assignment, arms, age, endpoint, estimand, missingness, safety, multiplicity, analysis code, and allowed labels; it receives no truth, transcript, model, feedback, or authority.
nodes.rationale: Reports cannot invent assignments, analyses, intrinsic-learning-rate labels, or development feedback.

nodes.after: A blindness auditor sees dependency manifests and taint receipts only; a lineage-safety auditor sees transaction/root/preservation receipts only; an authority verifier sees only their narrow attestations plus a new exact external human authorization. No auditor authors authority.
nodes.rationale: The prior omniscient auditor created a protected-evidence-to-release path.

nodes.before: V6 test ordering and G0 root binding were incomplete.
nodes.after: The exact DAG d176787d89784b54ed0fa65e47d0f08521835d49d4486c9e317e08ce64e3e6ca gates 44 actions in constructible STATIC_SCHEMA, G0_FAKE_RUNTIME, G1_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW, G2_CPU_DOMAIN, G3_GPU_SCIENCE, and G4_CLAIM order. Exact G0 authorization binds registry, DAG, parser, issuer, bridge, validator, gate, fake fixtures/dispatchers, fault fixtures, path/scope manifests, expected outputs, action, scope, nonce, and expiry.
nodes.rationale: No dynamic test precedes its implementation and no protected action produces its own prerequisite.

nodes.before: No separately closed postconstruction staging principal existed.
nodes.after: Only after candidate closure, E4_CANDIDATE_STAGER receives a non-dereferenceable sealed descriptor and equality-only committed-snapshot handle. It may stage or reject the already closed candidate but cannot read, alter, or reconstruct candidate bytes.
nodes.rationale: Prior-head mutation can change only staging status, never candidate construction.

nodes.before: Matched solo opportunity was prose rather than an action prerequisite.
nodes.after: FROZEN_MATCHED_SOLO_RESOURCE_OPPORTUNITY_CONTRACT and R_MATCHED_SOLO_RESOURCE_OPPORTUNITY_FROZEN equality-bind arm/root identities, exposure/order, parent and nonparent opportunities, tools, affordances, generated tokens, actions, wall time, retries, calls, CPU/GPU allocation, initialized optimizer/write opportunities, and every covered action.
nodes.rationale: Resource or opportunity inequality stops the affected generation or execution before it begins.

nodes.before: Full coverage and finite matched dose could conflict silently.
nodes.after: FROZEN_CUMULATIVE_COVERAGE_DOSE_CONTRACT fixes the eligible closure, deterministic order, at least one loss-bearing inclusion per proposition, meaning-preserving render rules, mask, tokenizer, truncation, batches, updates, optimizer, rank, exposure accounting, equality rules, finite ceilings, missingness, and stopping. Overflow stops before a writer call.
nodes.rationale: The life may be capacity-limited, but evidence may never be silently omitted or budgets increased post hoc.

edges.before: Bootstrap arms may be independently sampled or selected.
edges.after: One pre-render canonical transition produces exactly one treatment row and one direct-solution row with identical action/outcome and optimizer slot.
edges.rationale: Pairwise construction prevents treatment-dependent admission and outcome selection.

edges.before: Bootstrap adapter could be stacked, replayed, or reused as a personal adapter.
edges.after: A sealed bootstrap adapter is merged by the reference algorithm; only its content-addressed birth is a personal writer base.
edges.rationale: The birth and personal memory have separate roles and capacity accounting.

edges.before: Parent influence could be mistaken for writer input.
edges.after: There is no direct edge: parent/repetition -> waking context -> child thought -> child action -> public outcome -> committed child trace -> independent eligibility -> later SLEEP. All parent/repetition bytes and side channels are forbidden from evidence, compilation, dose, candidates, and gradients.
edges.rationale: Repetition remains parenting in THINK, never disguised post-training.

edges.before: Candidate artifacts and marker files can become independently visible.
edges.after: The writer closes candidate bytes before an equality-only snapshot bind. Candidate construction has immutable-birth, fresh-zero-delta, cumulative-evidence, frozen-contract, and seed inputs only. The evaluator may later dereference prior and candidate weights; the promotion gate receives only candidate-root equality, its bound verdict, and a full-head CAS binding.
edges.rationale: Prior weights may judge the candidate afterward but can never condition how it was constructed.

edges.before: SLEEP listed the mixed repetition root as a read.
edges.after: No semantic edge exists. Only the adaptive parent may read its own frozen-schema acquisition/relapse state; the fixed parent cannot. Auditors receive narrow taint or transaction receipts rather than repetition content. SLEEP receives only independently supported child-grounded life evidence.
edges.rationale: Repetition can guide adaptive waking parenting but cannot become a teacher-to-gradient or audit-to-release channel.

edges.before: Candidate and scientific evaluation were conflated.
edges.after: Private preservation evidence produces one promotion verdict; the gate consumes only that verdict and the staged candidate descriptor.
edges.rationale: Candidate safety affects only weight promotion.

edges.before: Evaluation products lacked a complete causal firewall.
edges.after: The executor closes an immutable transcript before the scorer receives it; hidden truth never enters the executor epoch.
edges.rationale: Generation and grading must be causally separated.

edges.after: No source edge exists. DREAM cache is waking-only and personal SLEEP resolves evidence from committed life data instead.
edges.rationale: Context compaction cannot silently become evidence compilation.

edges.after: Only frozen typed score records cross; transcripts, hidden truth, model state, and lineage capabilities do not.
In the fixed arm only, immutable age-keyed lesson bytes enter current waking context from an external cursor; child state cannot alter selection, bytes, timing, or repetition.
edges.rationale: Repetition is a waking intervention, not SLEEP data.

edges.before: Support decisions lacked an exact resolver-contract root.
edges.after: The resolver admits a clause only from exact child proposition IDs, public support IDs, life/commit roots, temporal classification, semantic scope, threshold, and the matching FROZEN_SUPPORT_RESOLVER_CONTRACT root; missing or undecidable support is rejection.
edges.rationale: The compiler cannot backfill rationale from outcomes.

edges.after: Detailed blindness and lineage findings remain quarantined. Only fixed-size producer-closed attestations plus a separately authored exact human authorization reach the authority verifier; the release controller receives its verdict and the identical complete release tuple.
edges.rationale: Audit evidence can establish facts but cannot manufacture permission.

edges.before: V6 exposed snapshot equality before candidate closure.
edges.after: A sealed-candidate bridge transfers only a non-dereferenceable candidate descriptor after candidate bytes and construction trace close; only then does the stager receive an equality-only head snapshot.
edges.rationale: Candidate bytes and trace are invariant to prior-head mutation.

edges.before: V6 checked equality and then wrote active weights separately.
edges.after: After independent preservation evaluation, one store-mediated PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC request binds expected full head, staged candidate, verdict, replacement root, namespace, nonce, and idempotency.
edges.rationale: Promotion is linearizable and retry safe.

edges.after: Every fixed/adaptive generation, parent, wake, writer, exam, CPU, GPU, and external-science action requires the exact matched-solo receipt naming that action and its equal resources/opportunities.
edges.rationale: Substitution or inequality fails before the first affected action.

edges.before: Reporter labels and assignments were ambient.
edges.after: A separate READ capability supplies the exact immutable analysis packet; score records and packet are the reporter's only inputs.
edges.rationale: Scientific reporting is producer-closed and label-restricted.

loops.before: Legacy compiler/writer paths and directory discovery are used across current lives.
loops.after: At SLEEP s the model-free resolver closes the full cumulative eligible corpus under K_support and K_coverage_dose. The constructor computes C_s := W(B_z,Z0_s,E_le_s,K_writer,K_support,K_coverage_dose,seed_s), then seals bytes and trace. Only afterward may the stager compare an equality-only head snapshot. No prior head or staging information reaches construction.
loops.trigger: After the frozen cutoff and all writer, resolver, finite-coverage/dose, matched-opportunity, statistics, and phase-receipt prerequisites exist.
loops.stop_condition: Unsupported semantics, missing cumulative coverage, parent/repetition/DREAM/prior-head/evaluation taint, nonzero initializer, overflow, or any root/dose mismatch denies the writer or stage and preserves life.
loops.rationale: SLEEP remains a fresh-from-birth compile-and-write over the child's own grounded life.

loops.after: Build paired target-blind T and D schooling rows before downstream instances exist. T shows one general feedback-to-action computation and D shows the identical canonical rational action directly, with every other opportunity matched. Train and materialize immutable births once; keep M0 as a separate diagnostic. The exact sources, row count, domains, rank, dose, and writer bytes remain deferred to a later frozen contract.
loops.trigger: Only after target-blind sources, paired-control construction, statistics, writer/materialization, and semantic-audit contracts receive their own exact authority.
loops.stop_condition: Stop for downstream-derived information, structural target overlap, unmatched action/outcome or optimizer opportunity, semantic-control failure, M0 damage, materialization drift, or nonreproducible roots.
loops.rationale: The bootstrap may lower the activation energy for parenting without teaching the deployment task or replacing lived learning.

loops.before: A fixed first-NOTE phrase and lexical overlap can be mistaken for parenting uptake.
loops.after: Repeat one core process lesson across varied waking cases until the child independently restates and selectively enacts it. Fixed parenting emits the same bytes at ages 1, 9, 17, and 25 regardless of history; adaptive parenting is a separately labeled later package. Parent text stays visible only during childhood waking context and remains loss-masked and absent from personal SLEEP.
loops.trigger: A fixed schedule event or a separately frozen adaptive-parent policy chooses a waking intervention.
loops.stop_condition: Copied phrases without grounded selective enactment are not uptake. Stop on any parent/repetition path into evidence membership, compiler rendering, dose, writer control, or gradients.
loops.rationale: Repetition is a teaching behavior in THINK; personal SLEEP only learns what the child subsequently makes its own through grounded life.

loops.before: Periodic and delayed writes can be narrated as a uniquely weight-mediated cadence effect.
loops.after: Compare prospectively assigned K4 and K1 lifetime roots through the same disposable executor, model-free scorer, and frozen analysis packet. Report checkpoint curves and the terminal total-package contrast; any standardized-ledger rewrite remains explicitly descriptive.
loops.trigger: Only at preregistered ages after matched opportunity, cumulative coverage/dose, one-way evaluation, statistics, and the exact phase receipts for the affected action.
loops.stop_condition: Unequal life opportunity, unregistered cadence changes, feedback from exams, missing roots, or an attempt to label a descriptive standardized-ledger contrast causal fails closed.
loops.rationale: Cadence is measured as a randomized total package without inventing a writer-only or history-only effect.

loops.before: Candidate scoring and scientific evaluation shared an implicit path.
loops.after: A fresh evaluator may inspect the sealed candidate and prior active child only after closure and emits a candidate-root-bound verdict. The lineage store then performs one PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC transaction or changes nothing.
loops.trigger: Only after candidate closure and postclosure staging under exact preservation and atomic-promotion contracts.
loops.stop_condition: A missing producer, stale head, changed candidate/verdict/root/namespace/nonce/idempotency, crash, retry, replay, or rejection leaves active weights and committed life unchanged and quarantines derivatives.
loops.rationale: Preservation may veto learning without conditioning candidate construction; activation is atomic.

loops.before: Evaluation products could affect continuing state.
loops.after: Fresh executors close transcripts before model-free scoring; the reporter reads only frozen score records and FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET. No artifact returns to child, parent, DREAM, SLEEP, lineage, audit, or release.
loops.trigger: Only at prospectively frozen ages after the exact matched-opportunity, split-evaluation, statistics, implementation, CPU, and authorized GPU phase receipts required for that action.
loops.stop_condition: Truth access by executor, model access by scorer, ambient analysis/label state, feedback, stale handles, or missing phase receipt fails closed.
loops.rationale: The exam measures rather than teaches the continuing child.

loops.after: Producer-closed blindness and lineage audits emit quarantined findings and fixed-size narrow attestations. A new external human authorization binds the complete release tuple. The verifier checks only those inputs, and the controller performs exactly one registered opaque transfer under the identical tuple.
loops.trigger: Only after all separately authorized prerequisites complete and a human authors exact, unexpired, one-shot authority for the named action and scope.
loops.stop_condition: No producer, stale or failed attestation, absent/mismatched human authorization, changed tuple, replay, expiry, inspection, or widened scope denies the action with constant-shape behavior.
loops.rationale: Science, audit, permission, and release are causally separate.

claims.before: R2 and the write swarm certify the intended native response-masked writer.
claims.after: R2 used the old compile_sleep/v1 writer and the swarm confounded augmentation with dose; they remain exploratory old-writer observations only.
claims.evidence_needed: Source and remote receipt audit already recorded; no successor credit.

claims.before: Corpus fit is treated as absorption.
claims.after: Conditional on later powered evidence, a personal LoRA freshly reconstructed from immutable birth plus cumulative grounded child-authored life supports held-out cue extraction and native action on fresh homologous tasks without textual retrieval, compiler-created cognition, or interface harm.
claims.evidence_needed: Powered independent-root source-fit, held-out extraction, native-use, adapter-off, deranged, wrong-life, replay/filler, preservation, provenance, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, and safety receipts.

claims.before: A bootstrap gain can be only higher entry skill.
claims.after: Conditional on Delta_R, T confers greater immediate selective use of novel correct process advice than paired direct-solution control D before any personal SLEEP.
claims.evidence_needed: Root-randomized T/D disposable same-state clones under correct, none, irrelevant, and wrong advice, with M0 reported separately as a competence/damage diagnostic.

claims.before: Adaptive parent behavior and personal SLEEP can be conflated with bootstrap receptivity.
claims.after: Conditional on powered Delta_F evidence, T modifies the entry-normalized developmental AUC of the total fixed-parent-plus-personal-SLEEP regime relative to D. This may be called an entry-normalized developmental AUC interaction or total-regime performance-curve acceleration, never an intrinsic or latent learning-rate change.
claims.evidence_needed: Powered primary D/T by absent/fixed independent-root factorial at ages 0,8,16,24,32 with matched opportunity, fixed bytes, clean one-way exams, raw curves, prospective uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, stopping, and safety.

claims.before: A full-system interaction can be called parenting alone.
claims.after: Conditional on separately powered Delta_E evidence, T modifies the entry-normalized developmental AUC of the total adaptive-parent-plus-child-plus-personal-SLEEP package relative to D. It is separately reported total-regime effect modification, not intrinsic learning rate or mediation.
claims.evidence_needed: Powered separately randomized D/T by absent/adaptive independent roots under the frozen policy, matched opportunity, full effort/information receipts, clean exams, raw curves, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, stopping, and safety.

claims.before: Cadence mediation is overidentified from terminal adapters.
claims.after: Conditional on prospective K4/K1 evidence, earlier SLEEP availability changes lifetime checkpoint AUC and possibly terminal performance as a randomized total package.
claims.evidence_needed: Matched prospective roots plus standardized-ledger and descriptive terminal contrasts under the narrowed labels.
